_comment: What town blacksmiths (the One Piece Mod's "smith" townsfolk) do for Arsenal gear: see town/Blacksmiths.java.
Hold something and talk to a blacksmith:
a part, with a material in your offhand: they forge a copy of it in that material. It takes the part's
crafting recipe's worth of material, less material_saving (never less than 1), plus a fee in Berries of
forge_fee + forge_fee_per_tier x the material's tier.
a part, with your offhand empty, carrying a full set of parts: they put the gear together for assemble_fee.
damaged forged gear: they mend it with its head material. Each piece mends repair_share of it (the
Shipwright's Anvil mends 0.25), and costs repair_fee Berries.
Blacksmiths never touch Navy materials or put together Navy gear. They do mend Navy gear.
towns: per town (the main mod's town structure id): price multiplies every fee, and the town's specialty
parts take specialty_saving more off the material.
